title: Extensions
statement:
Let $\mathcal A$ be an abelian category [def-sp-abelian] and $D(\mathcal A)$ its derived category [def-weil-abstract-derived-category]: the localization $Q:\mathrm{CoCh}(\mathcal A)\to D(\mathcal A)$ of the category of cochain complexes of $\mathcal A$ at the quasi-isomorphisms, an additive category with the shift functor $K\mapsto K[1]$, $(K[1])^r=K^{r+1}$ with differential $-d_K$; write $K[i]$ for its $i$-fold iterate. An object $M$ of $\mathcal A$ is regarded as the object $M[0]=Q(M[0])$ of $D(\mathcal A)$, where $M[0]$ is the complex with $M$ in degree $0$ and $0$ in every other degree. For objects $M,N$ of $\mathcal A$ and an integer $i\ge0$, the *$i$-th Ext group* of $M$ by $N$ is the abelian group

$$
\operatorname{Ext}^{i}_{\mathcal A}(M,N)\;:=\;\Hom_{D(\mathcal A)}\bigl(M[0],\;N[0][i]\bigr)
$$

of morphisms in the additive category $D(\mathcal A)$. For morphisms $a:M'\to M$ and $b:N\to N'$ of $\mathcal A$, the maps $a^*:\operatorname{Ext}^i_{\mathcal A}(M,N)\to\operatorname{Ext}^i_{\mathcal A}(M',N)$ and $b_*:\operatorname{Ext}^i_{\mathcal A}(M,N)\to\operatorname{Ext}^i_{\mathcal A}(M,N')$ are $\xi\mapsto\xi\circ Q(a[0])$ and $\xi\mapsto Q(b[0])[i]\circ\xi$; this makes $\operatorname{Ext}^i_{\mathcal A}(-,-)$ a functor $\mathcal A^{\mathrm{op}}\times\mathcal A\to\mathrm{Ab}$, additive in each variable. For a commutative ring $R$ and $\mathcal A$ the abelian category of $R$-modules one writes $\operatorname{Ext}^i_R(M,N)$; for a scheme $X$ and $\mathcal A$ the category of $\mathcal O_X$-modules, $\operatorname{Ext}^i_{\mathcal O_X}(\mathcal F,\mathcal G)$. (The description of $\operatorname{Ext}^i_{\mathcal A}(M,N)$ as $H^i(\Hom_{\mathcal A}(M,I^\bullet))$ for an injective resolution $N\to I^\bullet$, i.e. as the classical derived functor $R^i\Hom_{\mathcal A}(M,-)$, is a theorem, recorded in `pointers`; the sheaf $\mathcal Ext^i_{\mathcal O_X}$, the $i$-th cohomology sheaf of the derived internal Hom, is a separate definition, also recorded in `pointers`.)
